source_title: Hull 2-2 Ipswich Enciso strikes again to earn visitors a point
source_excerpt:
Hull maintained their unbeaten home record, but their winless run stretched to eight games after Julio Enciso earned Ipswich a draw at the MKM Stadium.
Ipswich had the lion’s share of possession in the first half, cutting through Hull’s defence repeatedly and Nobel Mendy and Konstantinos Tzolakis were unable to prevent Florentino Luis’s 22nd-minute opener as he sliced through on the right unhindered.
After 37 minutes, the visitors appeared to have doubled their lead as Enciso headed in from a corner, but the effort was disallowed for a foul on Oli McBurnie.
Hull upped their game after the break and after 58 minutes Tim Iroegbunam raced down the right and fired home the equaliser.
The pattern of the game changed entirely and 10 minutes later McBurnie slammed the ball beyond Christian Walton from a free-kick to giveHull the lead.
But it lasted only six minutes as Enciso worked his way through Hull’s backline to produce a stylish leveller from just outside the area. It followed his equaliser last week that earned his side a 1-1 draw against Nottingham Forest .
“We were excellent, the better side for almost all of it,” said the Ipswich manager, Gary O’Neil. “There’s disappointment that it doesn’t get us three [points], but a point on the road in the Premier League is still something.
“There was a lot of promise that we were much better than them in their own stadium. That takes some doing, they’re a good side and they’ve been doing well. You have to give them credit, they’ve done this against everybody.
“They don’t dominate the game, they don’t batter your goal, but if you make a mistake they will capitalise on it and that was the case today.”
After dominating possession early on Ipswich were rewarded with Florentino slipping past Mendy to leave Tzolakis with no chance as the ball flew past him and into the right corner.
Just over 10 minutes later the visitors threatened again, this time turning a corner, but it was chalked off as the referee, Thomas Kirk, adjudged McBurnie had been fouled by Abdul Fatawu.
After the break, Ipswich continued to cause Hull problems, with Emersonn hitting the side-netting, having worked his way neatly through Hull’s back four. At the other end Walton was tested by a Lewie Coyle cross.
The hosts were pressing and the equaliser arrived when Iroegbunam was played through in space by a fine McBurnie pass and fired home.
The home side continued to look increasingly threatening, with Coyle going close with a shot that went wide before McBurnie stuck a 68th-minute free-kick through the wall.
Hull could not keep hold of the lead, however, and Enciso picked his way through the defence to fire home impressively and make it 2-2.
“We should have controlled the last 20 minutes better because Enciso scored an excellent goal, but still we could have defended it,” said the Hull manager, Sergej Jakirovic. “But if you cannot win, at least don’t lose. I know we are waiting now for almost two months for a win, but I am still positive.”

## एमकेएम स्टेडियम में रोमांचक मुकाबला

हाल ही में खेले गए एक फुटबॉल मैच में हल और इप्सविच का मुकाबला 2-2 की बराबरी पर छूटा। इस परिणाम के बाद हल का अपने घरेलू मैदान पर अजेय रहने का रिकॉर्ड तो कायम रहा, लेकिन उनकी जीत का सिलसिला लगातार आठ मैचों से थम गया है। 

मैच के शुरुआती हिस्से में इप्सविच ने खेल पर अपनी पकड़ बनाई। खेल के 22वें मिनट में फ्लोरेंटिनो लुइस ने शानदार गोल कर मेहमान टीम इप्सविच को बढ़त दिलाई। इसके बाद 37वें मिनट में जूलियो एनसिस्को ने कॉर्नर पर एक और गोल किया, जिसे रेफरी थॉमस किर्क ने ओली मैकबर्नी पर फाउल दिए जाने के कारण अमान्य घोषित कर दिया।

## दूसरे हाफ में हल की वापसी

मैच के दूसरे हिस्से में घरेलू टीम हल ने अपने प्रदर्शन में सुधार किया।
* 58वें मिनट में टिम इरोज़बुनम ने दाईं ओर से आगे बढ़ते हुए बराबरी का गोल दागा।
* इसके दस मिनट बाद, 68वें मिनट में ओली मैकबर्नी ने फ्री-किक के जरिए गोल कर हल को 2-1 की बढ़त दिला दी।

हालांकि, यह बढ़त ज्यादा देर टिक नहीं पाई। इसके महज छह मिनट बाद जूलियो एनसिस्को ने हल की रक्षापंक्ति को भेदते हुए पेनल्टी एरिया के बाहर से एक और शानदार गोल किया और स्कोर 2-2 कर दिया। एनसिस्को का यह लगातार दूसरा गोल है, जिन्होंने पिछले हफ्ते नॉटिंघम फॉरेस्ट के खिलाफ भी अपनी टीम के लिए बराबरी का गोल दागा था।

## प्रबंधकों की प्रतिक्रियाएं

मैच के बाद दोनों टीमों के प्रबंधकों ने अपनी राय साझा की। इप्सविच के प्रबंधक गैरी ओ'नील ने दावा किया कि उनकी टीम मैच के अधिकांश समय बेहतर स्थिति में थी और उन्होंने मेहमान के रूप में एक अंक हासिल करने को सकारात्मक बताया। वहीं, हल के प्रबंधक सर्गेई जाकिरोविक ने स्वीकार किया कि उनकी टीम अंतिम 20 मिनटों को बेहतर ढंग से नियंत्रित कर सकती थी, लेकिन उन्होंने इस बात पर संतोष जताया कि हार से बचने में सफलता मिली।

दर्शकों और खेल प्रेमियों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे इस मैच से जुड़ी आधिकारिक घोषणाओं और विस्तृत सांख्यिकी के लिए संबंधित लीग के आधिकारिक पोर्टल की जांच करें।

## Hull Extend Winless Run Despite Home Resilience

Hull maintained their unbeaten home record with a 2-2 draw against Ipswich at the MKM Stadium, though the result extends their winless run to eight matches. According to match reports, Ipswich controlled large portions of the first half, breaking through the home defense in the 22nd minute when Florentino Luis capitalized on space to score the opener past goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis.

Ipswich appeared to extend their lead shortly before halftime when Julio Enciso headed in from a corner. However, referee Thomas Kirk disallowed the goal following an adjudged foul on Hull's Oli McBurnie.

## Second-Half Turnaround

Hull shifted the momentum after the interval:
* **58th minute:** Tim Iroegbunam raced down the right flank to equalize after receiving a pass from McBurnie.
* **68th minute:** McBurnie converted a free-kick through the wall, beating Ipswich goalkeeper Christian Walton to give Hull a 2-1 lead.

The advantage proved short-lived. Just six minutes later, Enciso navigated through Hull's defensive line and fired a low shot from outside the area to level the score at 2-2, echoing his previous goal against Nottingham Forest.

## Post-Match Reactions

Ipswich manager Gary O'Neil expressed mixed feelings after the final whistle, stating his team was "the better side for almost all of it" while acknowledging that a point away from home in the Premier League remains a positive result. 

Meanwhile, Hull manager Sergej Jakirovic admitted disappointment regarding the final stages of the match. "We should have controlled the last 20 minutes better... but if you cannot win, at least don't lose," Jakirovic said, addressing his side's nearly two-month wait for a victory.
